thread_text:
Aisha (PM): quick drop 3
Proposal: a compact cutover playbook + optional migration-concierge pricing. Short takes pls.

Raj (Staff Architect): +1. Must include model-compat matrix and an immutable rollout_id for each migration. Fallback precedence: region -> family -> quant.

Mei (SRE): Launch gates: 6h synthetic dry-run, staged ramp (5/25/100), 24h canary SLO hold (p95 + error). Panic criteria = error rate > 3x or p95 > 1.3x baseline. Need runbook template.

Lina (Infra Eng): Capacity notes: expose buffer_percent, preprovision_window_minutes. Require dry-run against reserved capacity before any tenant full cutover. Add eviction window for noisy tenants.

Leah (Sales): Pricing: migration-concierge tiers (Small/Mid/Enterprise). Enterprise gets guaranteed weekend slots + SE on-call. Include a rollback credit clause (72h).

Omar (Security): Residency check step: verify KMS scope & audit retention before enabling DSL for tenant. Logging retention should be configurable per contract.

Aisha (PM): minimal DSL example: `policy { tenant: "T-42" route_priority: [region,model_family,quant] fallback_ttl: 300 }`

Mei (SRE): ops playbook (short): `1) confirm reserves 2) enable DSL at 10% 3) monitor latency, errors, quality 4) roll back on panic`

Raj (Staff Architect): telemetry: expose routing_reason per request and tag rollout_id + tenant_id. Ops must be able to pin to a known-good variant.

Aisha (PM): next actions: Raj/Lina draft DSL min grammar EOW, Mei runbook + smoke tests by Wed, Leah/Priya pricing copy by Fri. deploy-bot: created RFC stub https://redwood/team/rfc/migration-playbook :white_check_mark:

Lina (Infra Eng): I'll schedule a 30m deep-dive Thu 11:00 to lock tradeoffs.

Aisha (PM): thx all 60; please reply with "i got it" for ownership. :rocket:
